mechanism: Primaquine may cause hemolytic anemia and methemoglobinemia, which can compromise cardiovascular stability in patients on beta-blockers; metoprolol may mask tachycardia symptoms that could indicate hemolytic crisis.
action: Monitor hemoglobin, hematocrit, and methemoglobin levels during concurrent use; ensure G6PD screening before primaquine initiation; counsel patients on signs of hemolysis.
